Kwame's question is answered in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to him on 03.11.2025.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest of 02.11.2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow". Bettina's recap note of 08.12.2025 gives the same official handoff date.
- **Day-to-day date:** The recap note says Bettina ran the account day to day until Kwame fully took over on 22.11.2025. I included that date and suggested 03.11.2025 for the CRM's official change-of-ownership field.
- **Date format:** I wrote the dates as day.month.year, the format Kwame asked for in his DMs with me. His reply sits in a channel his teammates can read, so they can see the format, but I didn't mention that it came from a DM.
